records.title: Twin Registration and Related Superstition
records.abstract: The twinning rates in 46 Prefectures of Japan were calculated from the vital statistic data in the period 1955.1959. The zygosity of twins was estimated by the Weinberg's differential method. The twinning rates increased from a low level in the southwest of Japan to a high level in the northeast.
